payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate now has a tested Rust-side auth bootstrap helper in crates/crate-rust-backend/src/auth_bootstrap.rs that mirrors its TypeScript onFirstSignIn product behavior, but Frick auth cannot call it yet. The needed framework seam should run once on new email/provider account creation before session minting, allow app-owned store writes, and return/override tenant_id/user_id/display_name consistently across email, Apple, Google, and OIDC.
